name: Minohodoshirazu no Koi to Uso
original_name: 身の程知らずの恋と嘘
source:
Narumi Yui, a second-year high school student, fell in love with Nisaka Ritsu, the most popular boy in school.

Narumi fell in love with him, who was unreachable, and repeatedly stalked him.

One day, Nisaka loses his memory in an accident.

Narumi then rushes to the hospital and lies that he is Nisaka's lover. ────

What will become of this lousy love story riddled with lies!

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7855]NovelGame[/url]]
